_about: Tacitus in English, translator per title. Alfred John Church and William Jackson Brodribb: Annals (1876; 1906 printing) and Histories (1864; 1894 printing), raw IA; Germany and Agricola ('the Oxford translation revised'), clean Gutenberg. W. Hamilton Fyfe's Histories (Oxford, 1912; Gutenberg clears it as US PD; Fyfe d. 1965). Thomas Gordon (1728-31): Germany, clean Gutenberg; his Annals I-VI selection is already on the Adler shelf. Arthur Murphy's Dialogue on Oratory. Latin-facing Loebs of 1930 or earlier added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row); the scan's printing was checked for a post-1930 revision notice where its title verso survives.

tacitus-oxford-germany-agricola: The Germany and the Agricola of Tacitus
tr. the Oxford translation revised (with notes)
tacitus-fyfe-histories: Tacitus: The Histories, vols. I and II
tr. W. Hamilton Fyfe (1912); US PD per Gutenberg
tacitus-murphy-dialogue: A Dialogue Concerning Oratory, or the Causes of Corrupt Eloquence

tacitus-church-brodribb-annals: Annals of Tacitus, translated into English with notes and maps (1906 printing)
tr. A. J. Church and W. J. Brodribb
tacitus-church-brodribb-histories: The History of Tacitus, translated into English (1894 printing)
tr. A. J. Church and W. J. Brodribb
tacitus-hutton-peterson-dialogus-agricol: tr. W. Peterson (Dialogus), M. Hutton (Agricola, Germania)

_cross_ref.tacitus-annals: Adler shelf: PG 7959, which is Thomas GORDON's 'The Reign of Tiberius, out of the First Six Annals' (ed. Galton), not Church and Brodribb's Annals as the Adler label says; the full Church-Brodribb Annals is now on this shelf
